products.name: Capital Guaranteed Super
products.description:
Capital Guaranteed Super account is a retirement savings account
(RSA) that offers a tax advantaged way to save for your retirement.
It is a low risk, low cost investment option with nominal monthly
fees.
The account is a capital guaranteed investment, meaning your
retirement savings are protected from negative earnings.
Retirement Savings Account (RSA) is a superannuation account
with the same tax concessions as any other superannuation fund,
however it operates similar to a savings/investment account.

fees.additionalInfo: When you break the fixed term, penalty interest  will be paid for the period from investment date  to redemption date. Penalty interest is the lowest  variable interest rate at the time of termination.

eligibility.additionalValue: Australian citizen, NZ citizen or permanent resident of Australia

constraints.additionalInfo: Minimum opening balance for fixed product

products.name: Capital Guaranteed Pension Account
products.description:
Capital Guaranteed Pension account is a complying account
based pension.
Account based pensions are designed to convert your
accumulated superannuation into a tax effective income
stream. This income is paid into your nominated bank account.
The minimum amount you draw from your pension account each
year is subject to a pension factor set by the Government and
other Government prescribed pension standards.

fees.name: Early termination of fixed rate
fees.additionalInfo: When you break the fixed term, penalty interest  will be paid for the period from investment date  to redemption date. Penalty interest is the lowest  variable interest rate at the time of termination.

fees.name: Administration fees
fees.additionalInfo: Deducted from variable interest option

eligibility.additionalInfo: You can commence a Capital Guaranteed Pension if you have immediate access to your superannuation  funds. This means you have met one of the conditions of release, such as: • You are under age 60 and have reached your preservation age and have retired permanently from the  workforce; • you are aged 65 or older; or • you have selected the ‘Transition to Retirement’ option.
